final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT cr.raceId AS race_id, r.name AS race_name, AVG(cr.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM constructorResults AS cr JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId WHERE cr.points > 1.0 GROUP BY cr.raceId, r.name), step2 AS (SELECT race_name, AVG(avg_points) AS avg_of_avg FROM step1 GROUP BY race_name) SELECT step1.race_id, step1.race_name, step1.avg_points, step1.record_count, step1.avg_points / step2.avg_of_avg AS ratio FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step1.race_name = step2.race_name ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
